newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Menem ready to decree Argentine home lender sale.
newsitem.headline: Menem ready to decree Argentine home lender sale.

text.p: Argentina's President Carlos Menem is ready to use a decree to privatize the state mortgage lender Banco Hipotecario Wednesday if Congress does not pass a law to sell it that day, officials said Monday.

"The president is determined. If lawmakers don't issue a committee resolution for a law to privatize it Wednesaday, he will sign the decree that very day," one government official told Reuters. Another official confirmed the first.
Plans to sell Hipotecario, valued at $2-3 billion, were launched in September last year and have sparked criticism in the ruling Peronist Party and among the opposition.
"Why sell it if it makes a profit?" asked the Peronist head of the lower house of Congress's Budget and Finance Committee, Oscar Lamberto, back in February.
Banco Hipotecario is the bank with the biggest assets in Argentina, at $4.31 billion. It made a profit last year of $306 million, versus $327 million a year earlier.
